modalLead: Four themes for Unraid users, a widget you can move to another page from its menu, and a long round of fixes.

items.text: Unraid Black, Azure, Ember and Blaze, each in dark and light, after the Unraid webGUI.
Your own themes are safer. A failed read no longer wipes them, their order is kept, and a theme made in another tab shows up here.
Move to page… in a widget's right-click menu.
The Calendar is more accurate: all-day events end at your midnight, cancelled events stay out, and the soonest events are kept.
Right-click menus are grouped with a line between open and share, edit, checking, select and delete.
Health, containers, backups, search and the inbox got dozens of fixes: lost settings, large backups, accented search, long inbox addresses and more.
